message.content:
A velvet wrap coat, tailored fit with wide lapels, deep emerald green (#043927), wool blend.  
A structured midi dress, A-line silhouette with a high neckline, frosted silver (#C0C0C0), heavy crepe.  
Heeled ankle boots, pointed toe with a 7cm heel, metallic bronze (#CD7F32), smooth leather.  
Gold drop earrings and a matching clutch bag in textured leather to complete the look.  
This outfit balances the frosty autumn weather with a luxurious outer layer that keeps her warm without feeling heavy. The deep emerald coat provides a rich contrast to the shimmering silver dress, ensuring she stands out elegantly against the holiday lights. Together, the textures of velvet and crepe add depth suitable for a sophisticated restaurant celebration, while the metallic accents tie the festive occasion together seamlessly.
